attempts.summary: Configured pam_pwquality on node1 (AlmaLinux 9) to require new passwords of at least 12 characters and at least 3 character classes (minlen=12, minclass=3 in /etc/security/pwquality.conf). Confirmed enforcement via real non-root user password-change tests both pre- and post-restart (weak passwords rejected, compliant passwords accepted). Restarted node1 with verified boot-identity change and confirmed policy persisted. All test users cleaned up.
